name: analytics
title: Analytics + real-user performance (Vercel)
summary: Cookieless page views and Core Web Vitals from real visitors, with token-bearing URLs scrubbed before they leave the page.
when: You want to know how many people visit, which pages, and how fast the site really is on their devices.
next: Enable Web Analytics and Speed Insights in the Vercel project dashboard.
If any route carries a secret in its path, add it to TOKEN_ROUTES in src/telemetry/scrub.ts.
